programme.desc: Arif (Landung Simatupang) dan Yati (Engelina Prihaksiwi) merayakan hari jadi pernikahan mereka dengan merekonstruksi foto lamaran di salah satu sudut Candi Borobudur.

programme.title: Bedah Rumah Lagi S4 E4
programme.desc: Bedah Rumah Lagi adalah program televisi yang mengubah rumah tidak layak huni milik keluarga kurang mampu menjadi tempat tinggal yang aman dan nyaman, sekaligus menghadirkan kisah perjuangan dan harapan baru bagi penghuninya.

programme.title: Lukas: The Journey of an Altar Boy S1 E1
programme.desc: Lukas (Aradhanara), seorang calon putra altar, tinggal bersama ibunya, Maria (Ruth Marini), dan neneknya (Lidya Kandau). Namun suatu hari, Lukas mengetahui bahwa ibunya didiagnosis menderita kanker stadium lanjut.

programme.title: Lukas: The Journey of an Altar Boy S1 E2
programme.desc: Lukas (Aradhanara) diberi tahu oleh neneknya (Lidya Kandau) bahwa ayahnya (Rizky Hanggono) masih hidup. Dengan bantuan dua sahabatnya, Flory (Chempa Puteri) dan Frans (Alif Anwar), Lukas pun mulai mencari ayahnya.

programme.title: Lukas: The Journey of an Altar Boy S1 E3
programme.desc: Saat mencari ayahnya, Lukas ditemani oleh Frans dan Flory untuk menemui orang-orang yang mengaku mengetahui keberadaan ayah Lukas. Namun ternyata hal itu justru membahayakan teman-temannya. Untungnya, Romo Eli datang untuk membantu.

programme.title: Lukas: The Journey of an Altar Boy S1 E4
programme.desc: Kali ini, petualangan Lukas untuk mencari ayahnya membuatnya ditinggalkan oleh sahabat-sahabatnya, Frans dan Flory. Namun, Tuhan tidak pernah meninggalkannya.

programme.title: Lukas: The Journey of an Altar Boy S1 E5
programme.desc: Episode terakhir, Lukas (Aradhanara) berhasil menyusup sebagai pemain ketoprak di tempat ayahnya (Rizky Hanggono) menjadi salah satu pemeran. Apakah Lukas berhasil bertemu dengan ayahnya?

programme.title: Edi (Ejakulasi Dini) S1 E1
programme.desc: Edi mulai memasuki masa pubertas dan menaruh perasaan pada seseorang yang terasa sangat sulit untuk diraih. Sahabat-sahabatnya kemudian mencari solusi melalui Google untuk mengatasi hal tersebut.

programme.title: Edi (Ejakulasi Dini) S1 E2
programme.desc: Masalah Edi semakin menumpuk, terutama dengan rival lamanya, Panji. Keadaan menjadi lebih buruk ketika Nataya, siswi baru yang cantik namun galak, tampaknya hanya memiliki masalah dengannya.

programme.title: Edi (Ejakulasi Dini) S1 E3
programme.desc: Anin mencurigai suaminya berselingkuh setelah menemukan tagihan klub malam di kartu kreditnya. Stres tersebut membuat sang suami mengalami ejakulasi dini.

programme.title: Edi (Ejakulasi Dini) S1 E4
programme.desc: Anin semakin yakin bahwa suaminya berselingkuh, dipicu oleh berbagai kesalahpahaman yang terus terjadi. Terlebih lagi setelah kartu kredit Dorman digunakan oleh Edi di sebuah klub malam, yang membuat penyelidikan Sarah mengarah pada kesimpulan yang keliru.

programme.title: Edi (Ejakulasi Dini) S1 E5
programme.desc: Edi mengetahui bahwa ayahnya mengalami ejakulasi dini, dan hal itu membuatnya takut memikirkan bagaimana jika suatu saat ia mengalami hal yang sama.

programme.title: Edi (Ejakulasi Dini) S1 E6
programme.desc: Keluarga Anin berada di ambang kehancuran setelah mendengar pengakuan Dorman tentang kebiasaan pesta liarnya di klub malam. Sementara itu, di sekolah, Edi menghadapi masalah ketika Panji merencanakan balas dendam dengan diam-diam memasukkan obat peningkat performa dewasa ke dalam minumannya.

programme.title: Edi (Ejakulasi Dini) S1 E7
programme.desc: Edi menghadapi dua kejutan: Nataya ternyata sudah dijodohkan dengan seseorang, dan Anin memutuskan untuk menceraikan Dorman. Edi menyadari bahwa pengeluarannya menggunakan kartu kredit ayahnya telah mendorong pernikahan kedua orang tuanya hingga berada di titik kehancuran.

programme.title: Edi (Ejakulasi Dini) S1 E8
programme.desc: Anin dan Dorman sepakat untuk mencoba konseling demi memperbaiki pernikahan mereka, sementara Edi akhirnya bisa melupakan perasaannya yang salah tempat terhadap Bu Julia dan menemukan cinta sejati bersama Nataya.

programme.title: Montir Cantik S1 E10
programme.desc: Indah sangat terpukul oleh kecelakaan yang menimpa ayahnya. Ia merasa bersalah, karena jika saja ia tidak bersikeras terjun ke dunia otomotif, Ramlan tidak akan datang ke tempat latihan dan mengalami kecelakaan. Indah bahkan tidak ingin lagi menjadi mekanik Geri dan memutuskan untuk membatalkan keikutsertaannya dalam balapan drag nasional.

programme.title: Entong
programme.desc: Animasi buatan Indonesia yang bercerita berdasarkan sinetron terkenal di MNCTV yaitu Si Entong yang ditayangkan pada tahun 2005 lalu.

programme.title: Bedah Rumah Lagi S4 E4
programme.desc: Bedah Rumah Lagi adalah program televisi yang mengubah rumah tidak layak huni milik keluarga kurang mampu menjadi tempat tinggal yang aman dan nyaman, sekaligus menghadirkan kisah perjuangan dan harapan baru bagi penghuninya.

programme.title: Liga DMD Panggung Rezeki 2
programme.desc: Menghadirkan 75 mantan juara DMD dari berbagai daerah di Indonesia, kompetisi ini mempertemukan para penyanyi dangdut berbakat untuk menunjukkan kemampuan vokal dan penampilan terbaik demi meraih gelar juara di antara para juara.

programme.title: Beyond Creator IDN Youtubers
programme.desc: Serial dokumenter yang mengangkat perjalanan para YouTuber Indonesia dalam membangun karier, mengekspresikan kreativitas, dan menghadapi berbagai tantangan di industri konten digital.

programme.title: Suparman Reborn
programme.desc: Bercerita tentang Ayat (Epy Kusnandar) yang balik ke kampung dan putranya, Suparman (Damar Rizal Marzuki) yang selalu sigap membantu masyarakat-

programme.title: Suparman Reborn
programme.desc: Bercerita tentang Ayat (Epy Kusnandar) yang balik ke kampung dan putranya, Suparman (Damar Rizal Marzuki) yang selalu sigap membantu masyarakat-

programme.title: Roy & Marten Sahabat Sehidup Semati S1 E6
programme.desc: Penyelidikan Roy atas kematian Marten menemui jalan buntu. Keadaan diperparah dengan kondisi keuangan Roy yang semakin menipis. Untungnya ada seorang politisi senior yang bersedia membantunya.

programme.title: Kiko
programme.desc: Kiko, seekor anak ikan mas koki yang sangat mandiri, walaupun ia anak tunggal. Kiko selalu riang dan memiliki empat sahabat baik yaitu Lola si ikan diskus, Ting Ting si kepiting, Patino si ikan patin dan Poli si ikan cupang. Di sisi lain, sosok antagonis, Karkus si ikan lele dan Pupus si belut, selalu membuat ricuh kehidupan Kiko.

programme.title: Piknik Pesona S1 E5
programme.desc: Heri (Ronny P. Tjandra) mengajak putrinya, Femi (Brigitta Cynthia), berlibur ke kampung halamannya di Bangka. Ia ingin menunjukkan kota yang memperkenalkannya pada mi Bangka yang selama ini ia jual di Jakarta. Heri merasa hal ini penting, terutama karena Femi akan melanjutkan usaha warung mi tersebut saat ia pensiun nanti.

programme.title: If You're Listening - Putin's billion-dollar bet against death
programme.desc: A hot mic caught Putin tell Xi that organ transplants could bring immortality. It's not just talk and it's not new either: Russian leaders have spent nearly a century chasing eternal life, with some genuinely bizarre results.

programme.title: Dr Karl's How Things Work - Toilet Paper
programme.desc: The battle for bog roll during the Covid 19 years showed us just how much we Aussies value the stuff. In this episode Dr Karl lifts the lid to discover how recycled toilet paper is made at the Encore toilet paper factory.

programme.title: The World This Week - Episode 43

programme.desc: Sam Wykes and Tinirau Arona are joined by Niall Williams-Guthrie and Kevin Naiqama to talk about the Rugby League World Cup Semi Finals. They explore what it means to wear the Samoan jersey and chat with Tonga's Will Hopoate.

programme.title: Alone Australia - Episode 6
programme.desc: Food is in extraordinary abundance for some survivalists, while others struggle with empty bellies and question their future in the competition.

programme.title: Weekend Breakfast - Episode 92

programme.title: Weekend Breakfast - Episode 92
programme.desc: All the news you need to start your day. Fauziah Ibrahim and Johanna Nicholson bring you the latest news, interviews, politics, culture, weather and global affairs. Plus sport with Daniela Intili.

programme.title: Weekend Breakfast (L)
programme.desc: Program ini menghadirkan kombinasi berita terkini, diskusi tentang isu‑isu harian, wawancara dengan tokoh penting, serta segmen olahraga dan cuaca akhir pekan untuk membuat pemirsa tetap terinformasi dan siap memulai hari.

programme.title: Insiders - Episode 42
programme.desc: David Speers and the panel discuss the week including climate on the agenda at COP31 in Turkiye, the upcoming APEC Summit, tax changes, aged care, AI, online safety and the final two weeks of the Victorian election campaign.

programme.title: Offsiders - Episode 41
programme.desc: The Kangaroos and Jillaroos through to the men's and women's Rugby League World Cup final against New Zealand. Abbey Gelmi and the panel cover the week including AFLW Semi Finals, Australia v England One Day Series and WBBL.

programme.title: That Pacific Sports Show - IRL Rugby League World Cup Special
programme.desc: Sam Wykes and Tinirau Arona are joined by Niall Williams-Guthrie and Kevin Naiqama to talk about the Rugby League World Cup Semi Finals. They explore what it means to wear the Samoan jersey and chat with Tonga's Will Hopoate.

programme.title: Back Roads - Grampians, VIC
programme.desc: When the land that lifts you up also brings you to your knees, how do you find the strength to rise? Lisa Millar discovers the strength and resilience of the people of the Grampians, in north-west Victoria. (Final)

programme.title: Landline - Episode 39
programme.desc: A tasty sampler of stories from the land - covering food, agriculture, crops, climate, business and innovation - as we meet the fascinating people who make our rural and regional communities unique. Presented by Pip Courtney.

programme.title: ABC News At Noon - Episode 92
programme.desc: Melissa Mackay presents the latest from ABC News on the weekend bringing you today's top stories and coverage of events as they unfold. Plus original reporting, analysis and updated news, sport, weather and information.

programme.title: The World This Week - Episode 43
programme.desc: Girish Sawlani brings you a weekly roundup of international news from an Australian perspective as reported by ABC News correspondents covering the Indo Pacific, Europe, North America, the Middle East, India and Indonesia.

programme.title: Eat The Invaders - Rabbit
programme.desc: Tony Armstrong visits ground zero of the rabbit invasion, exploring why Australia abandoned a beloved cuisine and considers putting underground mutton back on the national menu.

programme.title: Australia Remastered: Nature's Great Divide - A Separate Realm
programme.desc: The narrow strait between the Indonesian islands of Bali and Lombok marks the boundary between the wild worlds of Asia and Australia. This is the story of life on each side of nature's great divide.

programme.title: Nature's Great Divide
programme.desc: Arus Wallace Line memisahkan satwa liar Asia dan Australia, menciptakan narasi paralel tentang keanekaragaman yang menakjubkan di seluruh wilayah alam ini.

programme.title: Tomorrow Begins Here
programme.desc: Explores the challenges and resilience of the people of Kiribati, focusing on their innovative efforts to sustain life amidst environmental challenges.

programme.title: Tampa: The Turning Point - Episode 1
programme.desc: When Afghan refugee Abbas Nazari boards a dilapidated Indonesian fishing vessel with over 400 others in 2001, he has no idea he's about to be at the centre of one of the most dramatic chapters in Australian history.

programme.title: I Was Actually There - Port Arthur Massacre
programme.desc: On an autumn morning at Port Arthur's historic convict settlement, a gunman walked into the Broad Arrow Cafe, killing 35 people. We go deep inside the experience, hear from first hand witnesses to understand what happened.

programme.title: Landline - Episode 40
programme.desc: Hosted by award-winning journalist Pip Courtney, Landline is Australia's only national agricultural television program covering stories from Australia's rural and regional heartland.

programme.title: Good Tucker - Episode 1
programme.desc: Suren and Matt try Sri Lankan Cuisine in the cricket-themed restaurant, Upali's.

programme.title: Recipe of the Year - Episode 1
programme.desc: Adam Liaw and Pia Miranda host this heartfelt cooking competition. Under the watchful eye of the iconic Country Women's Association, home cooks from across Australia compete with the recipes that tell their stories.

programme.title: ABC National News - Episode 319
programme.desc: There's never been a more important time for transparency and trust. ABC News brings you today's top stories and latest news, with more reporters to tell you what's going on and why it matters. Presented by Meredith Sheehan.

programme.title: Stuff The British Stole - Parthenon Sculptures
programme.desc: Stephen Fry joins Marc Fennell on a gripping adventure, from the pinnacle of the Acropolis to a secluded robotics lab high in the Tuscan mountains to a shipwreck under the Aegean Sea.

programme.title: Our Medicine - Episode 1
programme.desc: Paramedic George and cadet Rob assist a stroke patient; medical student Keisha conducts her first practical medical check; Aboriginal Health Liaison Officer Brett supports a patient through surgery.

programme.title: Uncharted Amazon S1, Ep 3
programme.desc: Jauh di dalam hutan Peru, seekor anteater sutra (silky anteater) berjuang untuk tetap terjaga, sementara seekor burung kolibri betina berusaha keras membesarkan anaknya. Selama jutaan tahun evolusi, mereka telah mengembangkan hubungan-hubungan yang unik dan strategi-strategi tak terduga untuk mengatasi perubahan kondisi lingkungan yang terus berlangsung. Namun, dengan segala kecerdikan yang mereka miliki, mereka tidak pernah siap menghadapi kedatangan spesies baru yang muncul di habitat mereka.

programme.title: Iceman: The Time Traveller

programme.title: Marcus Stewart - The Fight Of My Life : PL Stories
programme.desc: Ipswich Town legend and former Sunderland striker Marcus Stewart built a career on taking on some of football's toughest challenges. Now, he faces a very different battle; one that has changed his life beyond the pitch and revealed a strength and determination far greater than anything football demanded of him.

programme.title: Mikel Arteta : PL Stories
programme.desc: We explore Mikel Arteta's impact at Arsenal and the managerial approach behind his success, reflecting on how his upbringing and football education in the Basque region shaped his thinking. We examine his tactics, how he develops players and the standards he sets throughout the club. We look at the key decisions that have turned Arsenal into Premier League champions.

programme.title: Tue 10 Nov : Match Officials Mic'D Up
programme.desc: Pro Ref Chief Refereeing Officer Howard Webb joins Michael Owen to provide context and explanation behind refereeing decisions, using match footage and previously unreleased audio between the on-field officials and VAR teams.

programme.title: Michael Owen: My Breakthrough Years : Rewind
programme.desc: Michael Owen burst onto the scene for Liverpool at just seventeen years of age, and in two consecutive seasons the teenage sensation won the Premier League Golden Boot. Owen recalls those campaigns for the Reds, reliving the key moments that helped him develop into one of the greatest players of his generation.

programme.title: 2017/2018 (Gb: Salah) : Goals Of The Season
programme.desc: We take a look back at some of the most spectacular and important goals from previous Premier League seasons.

programme.title: (Subbed) Pep - The Legacy : PL Stories
programme.desc: As Manchester City embark on a new chapter, we celebrate the extraordinary legacy of Pep Guardiola, the visionary who transformed not only a football club, but the Premier League itself. From his formative years as a player and coach to redefining excellence in English football, we trace the journey that made him one of the greatest managers the game has ever seen. Through unprecedented success, relentless innovation and a lasting influence on generations to come, this is the story of the man who changed the standards by which every Premier League manager is measured.

programme.title: (Subbed) Roberto Mancini : PL Stories
programme.desc: From a celebrated playing career in Italy to becoming the man who transformed Manchester City into Premier League champions, Roberto Mancini's footballing life has been filled with triumph, drama and unforgettable characters. PL Stories explores his fiery relationship with Mario Balotelli, 'that' extraordinary final-day victory over QPR, and the deep friendship he shared with the late Gianluca Vialli. Mancini's interview is brutally honest, highlighting the defining moments and extraordinary career of one of football's most compelling characters.

programme.title: Kai Havertz : The Big Interview
programme.desc: As a young boy cheering from the terraces of his hometown club, Alemannia Aachen, Kai Havertz fell in love with a striker by the name of Erik Meijer. In this Extended version of the first Masterclass of the new season, Havertz' footballing icon surprises him at training, before the two share tricks of the trade on the art of forward play, recreating some of the Arsenal striker's best goals.

programme.title: Patrick Vieira : The Big Interview
programme.desc: From street football in Senegal to becoming Arsenal captain, Patrick Vieira reflects on the journey that shaped one of the league's most iconic figures, as he tells Steve Bower about the proudest chapter of his career: the 2003-04 Invincibles season.

programme.title: Peter & Kasper Schmeichel : The Big Interview
programme.desc: Sharing 6 Premier League trophies between them, Peter and Kasper Schmeichel can be classed individually amongst the best goalkeepers of the Premier League era. This week, the Big Interview takes the rare opportunity of having father and son together. The pair discuss their fascinating dynamic, a relationship that developed from Kasper's formative years growing up around a father who won 5 Premier League titles in a dominant Manchester United side. The pair then share incredible insight around the evolution of the art of goalkeeping, spanning their own careers to the present day.

programme.desc: After more than two decades at the top, Ashley Young looks back on an incredible Premier League career. From breaking through at Watford and starring for Aston Villa to becoming a champion with Manchester United and playing on until the age of 40, Ashley counts down the 10 moments that defined his time at the very top of English football.

programme.desc: Each Premier League game from the 2026/27 season condensed into an individual 26-minute highlights show.

programme.title: Hayden Hackney : The Big Interview
programme.desc: From Middlesbrough ball boy to the Championship Player of the Season in 2025/26, Hayden Hackney tells Betty Glover about his start to life in the Premier League with Everton, the culmination of a lifetime of persistence and turning a childhood dream into a reality.

programme.title: Romeo Lavia : The Big Interview
programme.desc: Romeo Lavia's performances at the heart of Chelsea's midfield this season suggest he is on the way to fulfilling the immense promise that persuaded Pep Guardiola to sign him for Manchester City, having spotted him at an under-15 youth tournament in Belgium. Lavia then impressed at Southampton but injuries and the burden of expectation have stalled his progress at Chelsea. The Belgian opens up on the challenges he has overcome so far and his hunger to make up for lost time under Xabi Alonso.

programme.title: Alan Shearer : The Big Interview
programme.desc: Alan Shearer reflects on a childhood where his eye for goal came naturally, and led to a career that ended with him setting a Premier League goalscoring record that remains unchallenged. The former Southampton, Blackburn and Newcastle man explains what makes a great striker, and reveals a piece of advice that he's passed on to a Premier League star of today

programme.title: Aston Villa 92-93 - Behind The First Season : PL Stories
programme.desc: Aston Villa's 1992/93 season had all the ingredients of a defining football story. Through special behind-the-scenes footage, PL Stories takes viewers inside Ron Atkinson's Villa, revealing the characters, camaraderie and mounting pressure of a gripping title challenge. From the dressing room to the drama on the pitch, this is the inside story of Villa's pursuit of the first Premier League crown.

programme.title: (Subbed) Fabricio Coloccini : PL Stories
programme.desc: We head to Chile to catch up with former Newcastle United captain Fabricio Coloccini, where he is forging a new path in coaching. He reflects on life in the dugout and looks back on an unforgettable Premier League career that made him a cult hero on Tyneside.

programme.title: Kevin Keegan : PL Stories
programme.desc: From fearless forward to one of English football's most inspirational figures, this is the story of Kevin Keegan. We chart his remarkable playing career with Liverpool, Hamburg and England before exploring his impact as a manager, where he inspired Newcastle United to become one of the Premier League's most captivating teams. Through triumphs, setbacks and an unwavering passion for the game, we celebrate the life and legacy of a true football icon.

programme.desc: At just 16 years and 361 days old, Rio Ngumoha became Liverpool's youngest ever goalscorer, scoring a 100th minute winner on his Premier League debut at Newcastle. The records kept on falling in the 2025/26 season as the young winger went from wonderkid to first team regular. The East Londoner reflects on his meteoric rise and the importance of family support along the way.

programme.title: American Ninja... S6, Ep 2
programme.desc: Pada episode ini, para peserta terbaik dari tahap kualifikasi di Venice Beach kembali bertarung di Finals-nya.

programme.title: Knockouts!: Floyd Vs Hatton
programme.desc: Acara utama dalam episode ini adalah Floyd Mayweather, Jr. dalam pertarungan terakhir sebelum pensiun dari dunia tinju, menghadapi Ricky Hatton dalam sebuah pertarungan super. Mayweather menyebut Hatton sebagai salah satu pesaing terberat yang pernah dihadapinya. Juga ada dalam kartu pertandingan ini, Saul (Canelo) Alvarez yang masih muda terus naik peringkat.

programme.title: FS Grand Sumo S12, Ep 5
programme.desc: FS Grand Sumo S12 adalah seri dari program yang menampilkan pertarungan-pertarungan elit terbaik dunia.

programme.title: Prison Fighters S1, Ep 3
programme.desc: Film ini mengangkat kisah nyata dari program kontroversial di Thailand, di mana narapidana dapat memperoleh kebebasan mereka dengan memenangkan serangkaian pertandingan Muay Thai.

programme.title: MMA 30 S1, Ep 4
programme.desc: Fukuoka, Jepang akan menyambut para atlet terbaik dalam dunia bela diri saat Karate 1 Premier League kembali digelar. Fukuoka akan menjadi tuan rumah bagi para atlet dari seluruh dunia, termasuk para Juara Umum musim lalu seperti Hikaru Ono dan Ayaka Saito yang akan berlaga di negara asalnya. Federasi Karate Dunia mengharapkan jumlah penonton yang luar biasa, yang menampilkan para peraih medali Olimpiade dan para kompetitor peringkat dunia, saat Karate 1 Premier League mengunjungi kota pelabuhan Fukuoka, Jepang, di FIGHT SPORTS.

programme.title: FS MMA: Materla Vs Grove II
programme.desc: Petarung veteran Polandia Michał Materla menghadapi petarung Amerika Kendall Grove dalam laga ulang. Kekuatan pukulan dan kemampuan grappling Materla diuji melawan jangkauan serta teknik submission Grove.

programme.title: The Junkyard Dogs
programme.desc: Mengikuti seekor anjing yang merupakan ahli melarikan diri, yang harus bekerja sama dengan teman-teman anak anjingnya untuk mencegah blok mereka dirampok.

programme.title: AfterDeath
programme.desc: Akibat tragedi yang terjadi di klub malam, lima orang korban tewas terbangun di sebuah pantai. Takut dan bingung, mereka mencoba memahami berbagai hal dan bertanya-tanya apakah mereka sungguh sedang berada di neraka.

programme.title: AfterDeath
programme.desc: Akibat tragedi yang terjadi di klub malam, lima orang korban tewas terbangun di sebuah pantai. Takut dan bingung, mereka mencoba memahami berbagai hal dan bertanya-tanya apakah mereka sungguh sedang berada di neraka.

programme.title: A Tale Of Two Guns
programme.desc: Di Barat yang tak ada aturan hukum, The Cowboys, kakak-beradik pembunuh dan pencuri nan terkenal, menguasai wilayah tersebut dengan tinju brutal dan senjata api. Namun, takdir akhirnya datang menghampiri mereka.

programme.title: The Curse Of Sleeping Beauty
programme.desc: Seorang pria mewarisi rumah leluhurnya dan sebuah kutukan kuno yang berasal dari Perang Salib.

programme.title: Exists
programme.desc: Sekelompok teman menjalajahi kawasan hutan terpencil di Texas untuk bersenang-senang di akhir pekan, namun mereka dibuntuti oleh Bigfoot.

programme.title: Bad Men Must Bleed
programme.desc: Film ini mengikuti perjalanan seorang pria yang memburu geng saudaranya di seluruh wilayah barat Amerika untuk menghentikan aksi brutal mereka.

programme.title: The Housekeeper
programme.desc: Seorang pembantu rumah tangga muda menerima posisi menjanjikan di rumah sebuah keluarga kaya, hanya untuk menyadari bahwa seseorang mungkin menyembunyikan rahasia yang mematikan. Karena tidak tahu siapa yang dapat dipercaya, dia harus memecahkan misteri tersebut sambil menghindari konsekuensi mematikan yang akan datang.

programme.title: Candy Land
programme.desc: Seorang wanita muda yang tampak naif dan taat beragama memasuki dunia bawah tanah pekerja seks di tempat peristirahatan truk, yang juga dikenal sebagai "lot lizards."

programme.title: The School
programme.desc: Seorang dokter yang tengah mencari anaknya terbangun dan berada di sebuah sekolah yang terbengkalai. Ia harus menghadapi teror supranatural dan ketakutannya sendiri jika ia ingin menemukan keberadaan putranya.

programme.title: Holy Ghost People
programme.desc: Demi menemukan saudarinya, seorang wanita muda menyewa seorang mantan Marinir pecandu alkohol untuk membantunya menyusup ke Gereja Pantekosta One Accord.

programme.title: The Devil's Trap
programme.desc: Seorang pendeta melakukan perjalanan untuk menyelidiki seorang tukang giling yang dicurigai bekerja sama dengan iblis.

programme.title: The Great War
programme.desc: Pada hari-hari terakhir Perang Dunia Pertama, sekelompok tentara AS dikirim ke belakang garis musuh untuk menyelamatkan sebuah peleton yang tersesat.

programme.title: The Curse Of The Clown Motel
National Security
programme.desc: Dua petugas keamanan yang tidak serasi disatukan untuk membongkar operasi penyelundupan.

programme.title: Punisher: War Zone
programme.desc: Frank Castle, yang dikenal sebagai Punisher, tanpa ampun membasmi kejahatan terorganisir, tetapi hal itu justru memicu perang yang lebih besar.

programme.title: Stealth
programme.desc: Terlindung dalam program militer yang sangat rahasia, tiga pilot berjuang untuk mengendalikan program kecerdasan buatan sebelum memulai perang dunia berikutnya.

programme.title: The One
programme.desc: Seorang agen ditugasi mengamati sejumlah dunia alternatif kala sosok lain dirinya nan jahat mulai membunuh beberapa duplikat dirinya yang lain agar menjadi Sang Tunggal. Bentrokan antardunia paralel pun terjadi.

programme.title: The International
programme.desc: Clive Owen berperan sebagai agen Interpol yang mencoba untuk mengungkap peran sebuah lembaga keuangan ternama dalam jaringan perdagangan senjata internasional.

programme.title: The Rundown

programme.title: Here Comes The Boom
programme.desc: Seorang guru biologi ikut bertarung dalam pertandingan seni bela diri campuran untuk mengumpulkan dana demi menyelamatkan program musik di sekolah tempatnya mengajar.

programme.title: Black Hawk Down
programme.desc: Kisah tentang 160 tentara elit AS yang turun ke Mogadishu pada bulan Oktober 1993 untuk menangkap dua letnan utama seorang panglima perang yang memberontak, namun mendapati diri mereka dalam pertempuran putus asa dengan pasukan besar Somalia yang bersenjata lengkap.

Namun, ketika roh jahat muncul, ia mungkin satu-satunya orang yang bisa mencegahnya membunuh orang hidup maupun orang mati.

programme.title: Memoirs Of A Geisha
programme.desc: Kisah mengharukan Nitta Sayuri, seorang wanita muda Jepang yang meninggalkan kehidupan di desa nelayan dan menjadi salah satu geisha paling terkenal di Jepang.

programme.title: Celebrity Family Feud S12, Ep 6
programme.desc: Dipandu Steve Harvey, Celebrity Family Feud Season 12 mempertemukan para selebriti, atlet, dan entertainer dalam persaingan seru dan menghibur. Setiap tim harus menebak jawaban paling populer dari pertanyaan yang diajukan kepada 100 orang, sambil berusaha memenangkan hadiah untuk amal pilihan mereka.

programme.title: Project Runway S22: Redemption!
programme.desc: Para desainer mendapat kesempatan kedua untuk memberikan kesan pertama dengan tantangan menciptakan busana yang mencerminkan gaya desain pribadi mereka. Selain para juri, nasib mereka juga akan ditentukan oleh beberapa wajah yang sudah dikenal.

programme.title: Matlock S2: Piece Of My Heart
programme.desc: Saat Olympia dan tim menangani kasus kematian yang tidak wajar, Matty bertemu dengan seorang wanita misterius dari masa lalu Senior; Matty merenungkan hubungannya dengan putrinya.

programme.title: Sheriff Country S2, Ep 5
programme.desc: Pada musim kedua, Sheriff Mickey Fox menghadapi ancaman kejahatan baru di Edgewater sekaligus kemunculan kembali ibunya yang telah lama menghilang. Di tengah penyelidikan berbahaya, Mickey harus menyeimbangkan tugasnya sebagai sheriff dengan konflik keluarga yang rumit.

programme.title: Fire Country S5, Ep 5
programme.desc: Musim kelima mengikuti Bode dan tim Station 42 saat menghadapi berbagai situasi darurat di Edgewater. Musim ini dibuka dengan festival Founders’ Day yang berubah menjadi misi penyelamatan ketika lubang besar terbuka di bawah Main Street dan menjebak sejumlah warga.

programme.title: Family Feud, Ep 13
programme.desc: Steve Harvey memandu dua keluarga yang saling menebak jawaban survei. Mereka berebut peluang pass atau play, dan keluarga pemenang maju ke babak bonus untuk meraih hadiah uang tunai.

programme.title: Ghosts S5: Michael Jackson
programme.desc: Trevor mendapat masalah ketika hadiah yang tidak pantas untuk seorang rekan kerja memaksanya menghadiri rapat HR yang hanya bisa ditangani oleh Jay; Pete tanpa sengaja memicu drama dengan Alberta setelah dengan santai menyebutkan kunjungan kejutan kepada mantan kekasihnya.

programme.title: FBI S9, Ep 6
programme.desc: Musim kesembilan mengikuti tim FBI di New York saat menangani berbagai kasus besar, termasuk terorisme, kejahatan terorganisasi, dan kontraintelijen. Musim ini juga menyoroti perubahan peran OA serta dinamika baru Maggie bersama rekan barunya.

programme.title: The Miniature Wife: Christmas
programme.desc: Lindy beradaptasi dengan tinggi badannya yang hanya 6 inci sementara Les berusaha menemukan solusi untuk mengembalikan bentuk tubuhnya seperti semula.

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen S25, Ep 8
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay kembali di Musim 25 “Hell’s Kitchen”, menampilkan para koki yang semuanya berusia di bawah 25 tahun untuk bersaing memperebutkan hadiah utama.

programme.title: Sonic The Hedgehog 3
programme.desc: Sonic, Knuckles, dan Tails kembali bersatu untuk menghadapi musuh baru yang sangat kuat, Shadow, sosok penjahat misterius dengan kekuatan yang belum pernah mereka hadapi sebelumnya. Karena kemampuan mereka tidak mampu menandingi Shadow, Tim Sonic harus mencari sekutu tak terduga untuk mengalahkannya.

programme.desc: Bahan yang sangat radioaktif dicuri dari fasilitas pembuangan limbah medis, sehingga tim harus melacak pencurinya. Eva mendapati dirinya berada di tengah situasi yang genting.

programme.title: Howie, Landau'S Adventures In Seabed
programme.desc: Seri ini menyampaikan nilai-nilai persahabatan, keberanian, keyakinan dan pengampunan kepada anak-anak dan menceritakan kisah-kisah yang dialami Howie dan Landau di dasar laut. Howie, seorang penemu cilik dan Landau, seorang ahli pengetahuan kelautan, pergi ke laut dalam secara tidak sengaja. Mereka datang ke Kerajaan Merman dan terlibat dalam krisis besar di dunia laut.

programme.title: Boboiboy
programme.desc: Saatnya Ash dan Pikachu memulai petualangan mereka di wilayah Kalos! Sepanjang jalan, mereka bergabung dengan beberapa teman baru seorang penemu jenius bernama Clemont, adik perempuannya Bonnie, dan Serena, seorang Pelatih dalam perjalanan pertamanya. Ash segera mencoba menantang Gym di Lumiose City, tetapi tidak terlalu jauh sebelum robot mengusirnya! Di sela-sela pertarungan Gym, Ash dan teman-temannya akan menjelajahi wilayah unik ini, bertemu semua jenis Pokemon baru, dan mencari misteri Pokemon baru yang menarik!

programme.title: The Marsupilamis
programme.desc: Marsupilami yang legendaris meninggalkan hutan belantara Palombia dan pindah ke tempat yang lebih liar lagi: kota. Di sana, si kembar Jade dan Mica mendapati dunia mereka terbalik ketika orang tua mereka yang seorang penjelajah mempercayakan tiga telur Marsupilami misterius kepada mereka. Setelah menetas, kedua saudara ini harus kreatif untuk menyembunyikan teman-teman baru mereka—lagipula, tidak ada yang tahu keberadaan makhluk-makhluk energik ini, dan predator bisa saja mengintai di setiap sudut.

programme.desc: Cerita bermula di sebuah rumah sederhana. Rusdi bersama istrinya, Novi, dan ketiga anak mereka, Andra, Novan, dan Vina, sedang berbincang di ruang tamu sambil menonton televisi. Karena Vina tidak bisa tidur, Novi meminta Rusdi mematikan televisi. Saat itulah, mereka mendengar suara tangisan bayi yang seolah berasal dari depan rumah. Karena penasaran, Rusdi dan Novi akhirnya menidurkan Vina di dalam boks bayi, lalu keluar untuk memeriksa keadaan. Saat sampai di depan rumah, Novi dan Rusdi sangat terkejut melihat Lila sedang menggendong seorang bayi. Lila memohon kepada Rusdi untuk merawat anak kandungnya yang bernama Cinta.

programme.title: Samudra Cinta

programme.title: Cinta Seluas Samudra

Saat Maya ternyata masih hidup dan berada di tangan Roni, sebuah konspirasi membuatnya percaya bahwa Andrian telah mengkhianatinya.

programme.title: Wajah Cinta Yang Lain
programme.desc: Rasa sakit dan cinta di ingatakanku akan terus kekal. Dan Sekarang, cinta itu kembali dengan wajah yang lain..? Wajah Cinta Yang lain dibintangi oleh Dinda Kirana, Ibrahim Risyad, Oka Antara, Aulia Sarah, Andi Anissa, dan Andri Mashadi.

programme.title: Wajah Cinta Yang Lain
programme.desc: Sebuah pengkhianatan mengubah hidup Asti untuk selamanya. Kehilangan wajah, keluarga, dan kehidupan yang selama ini ia percaya, Asti bangkit dengan identitas baru untuk membongkar konspirasi yang menghancurkan hidupnya. Di balik setiap kebenaran yang terungkap, ia harus memilih antara membalas dendam atau memperjuangkan masa depan anak yang menjadi satu-satunya alasan ia bertahan hidup.

programme.title: Kesetiaan
programme.desc: Nadya (ANGGIKA BOLSTERLI), seorang dosen sukses, telah menikah dengan Pram (OMAR DANIEL). Setelah Pram kehilangan pekerjaan dan berkali-kali gagal membangun bisnis karena insiden kecelakaan di masa lalu, Nadya menjadi tulang punggung keluarga. Merasa rendah diri, Pram berubah menjadi suami toxic yang suka merendahkan, mengontrol, dan selalu cemburu dengan istrinya, apalagi ada Aris (RIONALDO STOCKHORST) mantan pacar Nadya yang juga menjadi dosen di kampus, semakin membuat Pram menjadi insecure sebagai suami Nadya. Namun semua berubah ketika Nadya membawa Citra (KEYSHA ANGELICA), mahasiswinya yang sedang mengalami kesulitan hidup untuk tinggal di kostan milik Pram dan Nadya. Pram yang merasa minder dengan istrinya ternyata menemukan kenyamanan yang ia dambakan ketika bersama Citra??? Saksikan keseruan ceritanya dalam SINETRON TERBARU KESETIAAN

programme.title: LES MINI-HÉROS DE LA FORÊT

programme.title: MY CLASS
programme.desc: Para guru mengajarkan konsep penting bahasa Prancis, termasuk ejaan, tata bahasa, dan konjugasi, melalui pembelajaran yang menyenangkan dan dirancang untuk anak usia 9–12 tahun.

programme.title: WOOLLY WOOLLY
programme.desc: Kakak beradik Lila dan Marco menciptakan berbagai cerita tentang Josie, Willy, Bibi, Pirouette, dan Chouchou. Di dunia yang terbuat dari rajutan, kelima karakter Woolly mengalami petualangan seru sambil belajar tentang persahabatan, kreativitas, dan kehidupan sehari-hari.

programme.title: TA VIE SANS ÇA
programme.desc: Ta Vie Sans Ça mengajak penonton membayangkan hidup tanpa benda, teknologi, atau layanan sehari-hari, serta merefleksikan kebiasaan modern.

programme.title: JAD ET SES SOEURS
programme.desc: Jad et ses soeurs mengisahkan kehidupan sehari-hari Jad bersama dua saudara kembarnya, Ranya dan Syrine. Dalam setiap episode, mereka menghadapi berbagai situasi yang dekat dengan dunia anak-anak, mulai dari kegiatan sekolah, permainan bersama teman, perjalanan keluarga, hingga tantangan kecil yang mengajarkan nilai-nilai kehidupan. Dengan latar budaya Maroko yang kental, serial animasi ini memperkenalkan tradisi, kebiasaan, dan keramahan masyarakat setempat. Dikemas dengan humor dan cerita yang hangat, serial ini mengajarkan pentingnya kerja sama, rasa hormat, tanggung jawab, serta kasih sayang dalam keluarga.

programme.title: CAPITAINE TONUS
programme.desc: Capitaine Tonus menghadirkan petualangan sambil mengajarkan kebugaran dan kerja sama bagi anak-anak.

programme.title: COMPOSTMAN ET MOI
programme.desc: Compostman et Moi adalah dokumenter yang mengisahkan perjalanan Florian Bonnet, seorang aktivis lingkungan yang dikenal dengan julukan "Compostman". Dengan semangat mengurangi limbah makanan dan meningkatkan kesadaran akan pentingnya pengelolaan sampah organik, ia berkeliling menemui berbagai komunitas untuk memperkenalkan manfaat pengomposan. Melalui kisah-kisah inspiratif, inisiatif masyarakat, dan penjelasan mengenai dampak positif pengomposan terhadap lingkungan, dokumenter ini menunjukkan bagaimana tindakan sederhana sehari-hari dapat membantu mengurangi sampah, memperbaiki kualitas tanah, dan mendukung gaya hidup yang lebih ramah lingkungan.

programme.title: LES SUPER-POUVOIRS DU VIVANT
programme.desc: Les Super-Pouvoirs du Vivant adalah dokumenter sains yang mengajak penonton menjelajahi berbagai kemampuan menakjubkan yang dimiliki makhluk hidup di bumi. Dari hewan dengan indera luar biasa dan strategi bertahan hidup unik hingga tumbuhan serta organisme yang mampu beradaptasi dengan kondisi ekstrem, film ini memperlihatkan keajaiban evolusi dan keanekaragaman hayati. Dengan bantuan penelitian para ilmuwan dan gambar-gambar alam yang memukau, dokumenter ini mengungkap bagaimana alam menciptakan berbagai solusi cerdas untuk menjaga kelangsungan hidup.

programme.title: Cafe Midnight
programme.desc: Yoon pergi mencari pengantin prianya, Taeyoung, yang tidak muncul di hari pernikahan. Secara kebetulan, ia tiba di sebuah tempat aneh bernama 'Cafe Midnight' dan menemukan Taeyoung yang berusia muda dari masa lalu.

programme.title: The Childe
programme.desc: Marco, seorang petinju yang lahir dari ayah Korea dan ibu Filipina. Akibat kesulitan keuangan dan ibu yang sakit-sakitan, Marco memutuskan pergi ke Korea Selatan untuk mencari keberadaan sang ayah yang sejak kecil meninggalkannya. Setibanya di Korea Selatan, Marco mendadak menjadi buronan seorang pria misterius dan sekelompok orang jahat yang tak pernah berhenti mengejarnya.

programme.title: Hi-Five
programme.desc: Hi-Five mengisahkan lima orang biasa yang hidupnya berubah setelah menerima transplantasi organ dari donor misterius yang sama. Tidak lama kemudian, mereka menyadari bahwa transplantasi tersebut memberikan kemampuan luar biasa yang berbeda-beda pada masing-masing orang. Saat masih berusaha memahami kekuatan baru mereka, muncul seorang pria berbahaya yang ingin menguasai kemampuan tersebut demi ambisinya sendiri. Terpaksa bersatu meskipun memiliki latar belakang dan kepribadian yang berbeda, kelima tokoh ini menjalani petualangan penuh aksi, humor, dan tantangan untuk menghadapi ancaman yang mengincar mereka. Dengan nuansa superhero khas Korea, film ini menghadirkan kisah seru tentang kerja sama, keberanian, dan persahabatan.

programme.title: The King's Warden
programme.desc: Berlatar belakang Dinasti Joseon, dan konon mengisahkan tentang raja keenam Joseon, Danjong, yang diasingkan ke Yeongwol, Provinsi Gangwon.

programme.title: The Noisy Mansion (tvN Movies)
programme.desc: Geo-Wool pindah setelah bertengkar dengan saudara laki-lakinya, Du-On. Di apartemen barunya di Baekse, dia mendengar suara-suara misterius di lantai pada pukul 4 pagi. Karena tidak bisa tidur, dia dan tetangganya menyelidiki sumber suara tersebut.

programme.title: War Of The Arrows (tvN Movies)
programme.desc: Berlatar saat invasi Manchu ke-dua di Korea, Nam Yi, yang merupakan seorang pemanah terbaik di Korea, melawan Dinasti Qing untuk menyelamatkan adik perempuannya, Ja In, yang akan diperbudak oleh penduduk Manchuria.

programme.title: Confession (TVN Movies)
programme.desc: Seorang pria yang menjadi tersangka kasus pembunuhan mencari bantuan dari seorang pengacara untuk membuktikan bahwa ia tidak bersalah. Saat mereka mulai mengumpulkan bukti-bukti, kebenaran pun perlahan terkuak.

programme.title: Whispering Corridors 6
programme.desc: Eun Hee kembali ke sekolah lamanya sebagai wakil kepala sekolah. Saat suara aneh dan sosok hantu muncul di toilet yang ditutup, ia menyadari misteri itu berkaitan dengan masa lalunya dan alasan ia kembali ke sekolah tersebut.

programme.desc: Setelah berbagai upaya bunuh diri gagal, sepasang suami istri memutuskan untuk tetap hidup, lalu bunuh diri di Tahun Baru.

programme.title: My Dear Guardian
programme.desc: Sebuah kisah yang mengikuti seorang petugas medis militer yang hangat dan lembut serta seorang perwira militer yang dingin seperti gunung es saat mereka menjalankan tugas, hingga akhirnya menemukan cinta.

programme.title: Ikatan Cinta
programme.desc: Mengisahkan tentang dua bersaudara, Andin (kakak) dan Elsa (adik). Tanpa mereka sadari mencintai pria yang sama, Nino. Hubungan mereka yang buruk menjadi lebih buruk ketika Elsa tahu bahwa Nino akan menikahi Andin. Pernikahan Nino dan Andin mendapat dukungan sang ayah, namun ditentang oleh sang ibu.

programme.title: Liontin
programme.desc: Manda dan Indy adalah kakak beradik yang saling menyayangi. Ibu mereka, Rianty, meninggal saat melahirkan Indy. Sejak saat itu, Manda dan Indy hanya hidup bertiga bersama ayahnya, Indra. Manda berperan sebagai ibu bagi Indy. Suatu ketika ayah mereka mulai sakit sakitan dan masuk rumah sakit. Ternyata Indra mengidap leukemia.

programme.title: Ternyata Ini Cinta
programme.desc: Ketika kehilangan mengubah segalanya, Luna harus bangkit, menemukan kembali harapannya dan menghadapi pertemuan yang tak pernah ia duga. Akankah pertemuan itu menjadi awal dari kebahagiaan atau justru membawa luka yang lebih besar?

programme.title: In Hell
programme.desc: Widowed when his FBI agent wife is killed by an extremist group, college professor Michael Faraday (Jeff Bridges) becomes obsessed with the culture of these groups -- especially when his new all-American neighbors, Oliver (Tim Robbins) and Cheryl Lang (Joan Cusack), start acting suspiciously. With each twist, the mystery deepens and questions loom whether Faraday is consumed by fear and driven by paranoia, or whether a lethal conspiracy has been born on Arlington Road.

programme.title: The Swordsman [English Dub]
programme.desc: A Hong Kong cop named Kit busts a major gangster only to find his cover blown and his main witness gone. The gangster, in retaliation, has him kidnapped and put in a Thai jail with a false criminal identity. Lowly prison guard Chai, with his extraordinary fighting skills, guards Kit and prevents his escape. The prison guard’s daughter suffers from a rare form of leukemia and Kit is the only donor who can save her. The prison guard discovers Kit’s real identity and helps him to escape in return for his agreeing to save his daughter. Together, Kit and Chai must face and take down the gangster and his minions.

programme.title: The Code
programme.desc: A veteran thief recruits a younger crook to help him pull off one final job in order to repay his debt to the Russian mob.

programme.title: The Devil's Arithmetic
programme.desc: Hannah Stern (Kirsten Dunst), an American-born Jewish adolescent, is uninterested in the culture, faith and customs of her relatives; however, Hannah begins to reevaluate her heritage when she has a supernatural experience that transports her back to a Nazi death camp in 1941. There, she meets a young girl named Rivkah (Brittany Murphy), a fellow captive in the camp. As Rivkah and Hannah struggle to survive in the face of daily atrocities, they form an unbreakable bond.

programme.title: Blind Horizon [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Found in the New Mexico desert with a head wound and total amnesia, Frank Kavanaugh (Val Kilmer) is brought to a hospital. When he recovers some of his memory, he begins raving about an upcoming assassination attempt on the president. Despite the man's unstable state, Sheriff Jack Kolb (Sam Shepard) is troubled by Frank's story. Discovering the truth grows more complicated when Chloe Richards (Neve Campbell) arrives and claims to be Frank's fiancée, even though he has no memory of her.

programme.title: Prom Night
programme.desc: This slasher movie follows a relentless killer who is out to avenge the death of a young girl who died after being bullied and teased by four of her classmates. Now high-school students, the guilt-ridden kids have kept their involvement a secret, but when they start being murdered, one by one, it's clear that someone knows the truth. Also coping with the past are members of the dead girl's family, most notably her prom-queen sister, Kim Hammond.

programme.title: The Long Walk Home
programme.desc: Odessa Cotter needs to get to work as a nanny in the home of the affluent Miriam Thompson, but she refuses to take the bus. Odessa is participating in the Montgomery bus boycott, protesting against the inequality between blacks and whites, so Miriam decides to offer Odessa a ride to work every day. Though the community and Miriam's husband insist she not get involved, the relationship between Miriam and Odessa has already changed for the better.

programme.title: Hunt for the Wilderpeople
programme.desc: A misfit kid and his foster uncle go on the run in the New Zealand bush, evading child services and the law.

programme.title: Cold Blood
programme.desc: A legendary retired hit man (Jean Reno) lives in isolation in the barren North American wilderness. When he rescues a woman from a snowmobiling accident, he soon discovers that she's harboring a secret that forces him to return to his lethal ways.

programme.title: Straight A's
programme.desc: Compelled by his mother's ghost, a former addict (Ryan Phillippe, "Crash") returns home to face his first love (Anna Paquin, "The Piano"), who happens to be his brother's wife.

programme.title: I'm Charlie Walker [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In 1971 two oil tankers collide off the coast of San Francisco, spilling millions of gallons of crude oil and creating an environmental disaster. Against all odds, trucking and construction entrepreneur Charlie Walker secures a lucrative contract to clean the coastline. However, he also finds himself fighting institutional racism from the very company that hired him.

programme.title: Jack's Back [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In a sickening coincidence -- or a sinister homage to actual crimes -- women are being murdered in Los Angeles 100 years after Jack the Ripper terrorized London. Police think John Westford, a young doctor, is the murderer, and when he's found hanging from a noose, authorities believe his apparent suicide is a tacit admission of guilt. But his twin brother, Rick (also Spader), insists John was killed, and, when it appears Rick is right, the investigation takes a stunning turn.

programme.title: Mysteria
programme.desc: Fighting to finish his script for a producer (Billy Zane), screenwriter Aleister (Robert Miano) finds inspiration amid a murder investigation led by Captain McCarthy (Michael Rooker) and his interrogator (Danny Glover).

programme.title: The Getaway (1994) [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Doc and Carol McCoy are married criminals looking for a high-paying score. When Doc ends up in a Mexican prison, Carol tells mob boss Jack Benyon that Doc will work for him if Benyon can free him from prison. Benyon hires Doc to rob a dog track, but after the heist goes terribly wrong, Doc and Carol escape with the cash. With a bitter thief and Benyon's hired help on their trail, Doc and Carol must fight to survive.

programme.title: Eye See You
programme.desc: Recovering from the psychological effects of witnessing a brutal crime, FBI Agent Jake Malloy (Sylvester Stallone) checks into a rehabilitation clinic for law enforcement officers in the remote wilderness of Wyoming during the dead of winter. He soon finds himself helping other patients as a serial killer begins killing them one by one.

programme.title: Hit & Run [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Charlie Bronson (Dax Shepard), a nice guy with a shady past as a getaway driver, breaks out of the witness protection program in a backwater California town to drive his girlfriend, Annie (Kristen Bell), to Los Angeles for an important job interview. The pair's road trip takes an awkward and dangerous turn when they find that an inept federal agent (Tom Arnold) and the mobster (Bradley Cooper) he testified against are both trying to hunt them down.

programme.title: The Contract
programme.desc: Frank Carden (Morgan Freeman), one of the world's greatest assassins, is handed a lucrative contract to kill a highly secretive billionaire. But in a twist of fate, Carden is involved in a car accident during the job, and when his gun is found after he is admitted to a hospital, federal marshals arrest him. Meanwhile, ex-cop Ray Keene (John Cusack) is hiking with his son, Chris (Jamie Anderson), when Carden's cohorts try to spring him from custody, and soon the pair is caught in the crossfire.

programme.title: Are You Here
programme.desc: In this touching dramedy, weatherman Steve (Owen Wilson) must join his off-the-grid best friend Ben (Zach Galifianakis) for Ben's estranged father's funeral.

programme.title: Just Getting Started
programme.desc: Duke Diver is living the high life as the freewheeling manager of a luxurious resort in Palm Springs, Calif. He soon faces competition from Leo, a former military man who likes the same woman that Duke is interested in. When Diver's past suddenly catches up with him, he must put aside his differences and reluctantly team up with Leo to stop whoever is trying to kill him.

programme.title: 10th & Wolf [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: While serving in the military, a Marine sergeant (James Marsden) believes his family's ties to organized crime are a thing of the past. However, an act of insubordination and a visit from the F.B.I. send him packing to his South Philadelphia hometown, and he discovers that his brother (Brad Renfro) and his cousin (Giovanni Ribisi) have become entangled with mobsters, leaving him with only one way to save them.

programme.title: Honest Thief
programme.desc: Wanting to lead an honest life, a notorious bank robber (Liam Neeson) turns himself in, only to be double-crossed by two ruthless FBI agents.

programme.title: Mercenary for Justice
programme.desc: As a mercenary, John Seeger (Steven Seagal) has a reputation that precedes him. That's why he's being blackmailed into performing a risky job: breaking the son of a wealthy arms dealer out of a South African prison. With his friends taken hostage, Seeger agrees to do the deed -- but finds out too late that he's been double-crossed. Not one who likes being taken for a fool, Seeger hatches an elaborate plan to get even that will make the prison break look like capture the flag.

programme.title: The Bone Snatcher
programme.desc: When four jewel hunters are found dead in the desert with the flesh stripped from their bodies, it's up to Dr. Zack Straker to find out what's gone wrong.

programme.title: Chef [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: After a controlling owner (Dustin Hoffman) pushes him too far, chef Carl Casper (Jon Favreau) quits his position at a prestigious Los Angeles restaurant. As he tries to figure out what his next step should be, he finds himself in Miami. Carl joins forces with his ex-wife (Sofía Vergara), best friend (John Leguizamo) and son (Emjay Anthony) to launch a food-truck business, and the venture provides a chance to reignite his passion for cooking -- as well as his zest for life and love.

programme.title: Blitz
programme.desc: Jason Statham stars as a tough cop who's dispatched to take down a serial killer who has been targeting police officers. Also featuring Paddy Considine and Aidan Gillen.

programme.title: My Baby Gone
programme.desc: Pregnant Emily bonds quickly with her pregnant neighbor Kelly, but Kelly is faking it and plans to steal Emily's baby.

programme.title: Kill Switch
programme.desc: A psychopathic killer is ravaging Memphis, Tennesse by murdering young women and Detective Jacob Stillwell is on the case. Known as the resident tough cop due to his aggressive tactics, he gets knocked sideways when his girlfriend becomes one of the murder victims. With his partner, Storm Anderson, in tow, Jacob casts the rules aside and infiltrates the seedy criminal underworld of the city looking to avenge his lover's death and put an end to the killings.

programme.title: Killing Season
programme.desc: Oscar winner Robert De Niro ("Raging Bull") and Oscar nominee John Travolta ("Pulp Fiction") star as two Bosnian War veterans hunting each other in this thrilling game of cat and mouse.

programme.title: 51st State
programme.desc: The 51st State is the story of Elmo McElroy (Samuel L. Jackson), a streetwise American master chemist, who heads to England to set up his last big deal -- to introduce a new designer drug to the European market. McElroy soon becomes embroiled in a web of double-dealing as he's escorted around Liverpool's underworld and rave scene by rabid local hood Felix De Souza (Robert Carlyle), who hates all things American.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: On his tour, Rookie discovers a small cow trapped in a pit and unable to escape on its own. He quickly rushes to its rescue and lifts it to safety. programme.title: Rookie Robot

programme.desc: In this coming-of-age documentary, four friends on the Autism spectrum who have bonded through humor and performed as the comedy troupe "Asperger's Are Us" will prepare for one final, ambitious show before going their separate ways.

programme.desc: Chloe, Dallas, and Ryan are three besties who work at Chicken Dinner Restaurant. They find a treasure map leading them to Fester Hopperfoot's gold. Based on the TV Program "The Chloe, Dallas, and Ryan Show."

programme.title: The Have Not
programme.desc: After a failed relationship, a deadbeat man tries to live off the land in a beach town on Long Island.

programme.title: Code Duello: From The Tithebanner Saga
programme.desc: Following a cataclysmic collision of galaxies, two survivors navigate the strange new world where they find themselves, searching for a place in society to survive and build a new life together.

programme.title: Saving Sally
programme.desc: Marty, a comic book artist, falls for his saviour Sally, a feisty gadget inventor. Afraid Sally might be getting abused by her adoptive parents, Marty strives to save her.

programme.title: Index Zero
programme.desc: 2035, a couple enters illegally in the United States of Europe. Here, an 'Index of Sustainability' is given to every citizen, calculated on their personal productivity and wellbeing. She is pregnant and is 'not sustainable'. She must to be expelled.

programme.title: Upstairs Inferno
programme.desc: For over 40 years, the 1973 New Orleans gay bar arson was considered the "Largest Gay Mass Murder in US History." Featuring heart-wrenching interviews with survivors, friends of victims, and witnesses, the film vividly examines the forgotten tragedy.

programme.title: An Honest Liar
programme.desc: The incredible true story of the renowned magician turned skeptic and exposer of frauds and hoaxes, James "The Amazing" Randi.

programme.title: Get Close
programme.desc: Tony Turner loses his father while in prison due to health issues. When he leaves prison, he meets a young lady named Kimaya, who he begins to fall in love with but refuses to allow her in, all while ducking the guy whose drugs he went to prison for.

programme.title: Target List
programme.desc: After announcing a ground-breaking cancer cure, five research team members are targeted by an assassin hired by big pharma. Two researchers soon find themselves framed for the crime and on the killer's target list when they escape the attack.

programme.title: Plots with a View
programme.desc: A woman, whose husband is cheating on her, and an undertaker, who has been in love with her since their childhood, decide to fake her death so they can be together.

programme.title: Harold's Going Stiff
programme.desc: Harold is suffering from a terrifying new disease that is turning him into a zombie. As his condition deteriorates, he and his friendly care worker end up on the run from a group of violent vigilantes.

programme.title: Barefoot
programme.desc: The underachieving black sheep son of a wealthy family meets a young psychiatric patient and takes her home for his brother's wedding.

programme.title: Jesus Of Nazareth
programme.desc: An all-star cast comes together to deliver a powerful adaptation of the Gospels in 1977's Jesus Of Nazareth.

programme.title: Inhabitants
programme.desc: Going against the wishes of their family members, Olivia and her boyfriend, Francis, move to California for an exciting new life. However, when Francis starts to sleepwalk and experience night terrors, the couple soon discover they're being haunted by a ghost that wants to punish them for their sins.

programme.title: Great White Summer
programme.desc: From the peaks of Cape Cod's surfing waves to the murky depths below, trouble runs deep on this beloved New England seashore after the first fatal shark attack in eighty years upends the community. With the predator population on the rise, and increasing encounters placing lives and livelihoods in peril, Great White Summer chronicles a season of struggle as people demand action, priorities are questioned, personal allegiances shift, and growing suspicion clouds the waters.

programme.title: Fittest on Earth: Final Showdown in Madtown
programme.desc: A diverse group of elite male and female athletes competes for the coveted title of Fittest on Earth in the 2023 CrossFit Games.

programme.title: Stylebender
programme.desc: An intimate exploration of a bullied outsider's battle to the top of the UFC, revealing Israel Adesanya's brutal, beautiful struggle to become the global phenomenon known as 'The Last Stylebender.'

programme.title: Killer Elite [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Danny Bryce (Jason Statham), one of the world's deadliest special-ops agents, returns from self-imposed exile after his mentor, Hunter (Robert De Niro) is captured. Danny reassembles his former team of skilled commandos to launch a rescue mission, and also to infiltrate the highly feared military unit, the British Special Air Service. The mission will not be easy, for Danny and his team must cut their way through Spike (Clive Owen) and a team of assassins known as the Feather Men.

programme.title: K-19: The Widowmaker
programme.desc: Follows Captain Alexei Vostrikov who, at the height of the Cold War, is ordered to take over command of the nuclear missile submarine K-19, pride of the Soviet Navy. His assignment: Prepare the K-19 for sea and take her out on patrol -- no matter what the cost. But problems with the K-19 arise that may lead to a core meltdown and explosion that will certainly kill all aboard, and possibly trigger a nuclear war. Vostrikov must choose between his orders and the lives of his men.

programme.title: Point Break [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: After a string of bizarre bank robberies in Southern California, with the crooks donning masks of various former presidents, a federal agent, Johnny Utah (Keanu Reeves), infiltrates the suspected gang. But this is no ordinary group of robbers. They're surfers -- led by the charismatic Bodhi (Patrick Swayze) -- who are addicted to the rush of thievery. But when Utah falls in love with a female surfer, Tyler (Lori Petty), who is close to the gang, it complicates his sense of duty.

programme.title: The Infiltrator [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In 1986, federal agent Robert Mazur (Bryan Cranston) goes undercover to infiltrate the trafficking network of Colombian drug kingpin Pablo Escobar. Working with fellow agents Kathy Ertz (Diane Kruger) and Emir Abreu (John Leguizamo), Mazur poses as a slick, money-laundering businessman named Bob Musella. Gaining the confidence of Roberto Alcaino (Benjamin Bratt), Escobar's top lieutenant, Mazur must navigate a vicious criminal underworld where one wrong move could cost him everything.

programme.title: Wish Upon
programme.desc: Jonathan Shannon (Ryan Phillippe) gives his 17-year-old daughter Clare (Joey King) an old music box that promises to grant its owner seven wishes. Skeptical at first, Clare becomes seduced by its dark powers when her life starts to radically improve with each wish. Everything seems perfect until she realizes that every wish she makes causes the people who are closest to her to die in violent and elaborate ways.

programme.title: Tomorrow Before After
programme.desc: In a post-apocalyptic world, a lone woman searches for survivors while coping with an unborn child growing inside her.

programme.title: Roswell Delirium
programme.desc: The story of an alternate 1980s where the U.S. is hit by a wave of nuclear attacks, and after the fallout those who remain, pretend like everything is normal even though they are all experiencing radiation poisoning. A young girl named Mayday tries to make contact on a series of ham radios with her father who is in space on a shuttle mission. Instead of making contact she receives an intergalactic distress call from space that leads her on a journey to Spacerock, the land where Area 51 once was.

programme.title: The Mouse Trap
programme.desc: Stuck working the late shift at the amusement park arcade, Alex receives a surprise visit from her friends on her 21st birthday. However, their night of fun soon turns into a fight for survival when a killer dressed as Mickey Mouse crashes the party.

programme.title: Shiver Me Timbers
programme.desc: In Northern California during the summer of 1986, Olive Oyl, along with her cinema-obsessed friends and brother Castor, embark on a once-in-a-lifetime camping trip to witness the dazzling meteor shower accompanying the arrival of Halley's comet. But what starts as a serene evening of stargazing quickly turns into a harrowing nightmare when a meteor from the comet transforms Popeye, into a terrifying and unstoppable killing machine.

programme.title: In Flight
programme.desc: The night before Claire Reynolds' trip to Paris, she catches the eye of a mysterious, handsome stranger. That's the last thing she remembers before waking up on a plane with no recollection of what happened after that.

programme.title: CAT 8
programme.desc: A research program once abandoned by the best solar physicist when the Pentagon wanted to put it to military use, has been resumed by his former deputy.

programme.title: CAT 8
programme.desc: A research program once abandoned by the best solar physicist when the Pentagon wanted to put it to military use, has been resumed by his former deputy.

programme.title: 10.5 Apocalypse
programme.desc: The aftershocks of a massive West Coast quake devastate the country state-by-state culminating in a possible nuclear meltdown.

programme.title: 10.5 Apocalypse
programme.desc: The aftershocks of a massive West Coast quake devastate the country state-by-state culminating in a possible nuclear meltdown.

programme.title: Timecop [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: When mankind perfects time travel, the government establishes the Time Enforcement Commission to thwart criminal attempts to alter the timeline. Police officer Walker (Jean-Claude Van Damme) is recruited by TEC Cmdr. Matuzak (Bruce McGill), but soon finds his investigation of Senator Aaron McComb (Ron Silver) being thwarted by elements within the government. When Walker's wife, Melissa (Mia Sara), is attacked, he must travel across time to rescue her and save the future.

programme.title: Before The Devil Knows You're Dead [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Andy needs some quick cash gets his younger brother into a scheme to rob their parents' jewelry store.

programme.title: Donnie Darko (Theatrical Cut) [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A troubled teenager is plagued by visions of a man in a rabbit suit who manipulates him to commit crimes.

programme.title: The Lost Princess
programme.desc: A billionaire gets transported to a bloody battle that leads him to an old castle in Morocco. He soon meets Hanna, who shares the tragic tale of her mother's forced marriage to a Saudi prince, and her secret love affair with a castle caretaker.

programme.title: The Fix
programme.desc: When a troubled model takes a new drug at a party, she suffers a shocking transformation. Pursued by authorities and a dangerous gang, she hunts for a 'fix' to reverse these effects, only to discover her mutations could save the human race.

programme.title: I'm Beginning to See the Light
programme.desc: After losing his family in a brutal accident, ex-trumpeter Ezra finds solace as a lighthouse keeper. But when two visitors reveal their true motives, Ezra must decide: let the light back into his life or stay in the shadows.

programme.title: The Lawnmower Man
programme.desc: The eccentric Dr. Lawrence Angelo puts mentally disabled landscaper Jobe Smith on a regimen of experimental pills and computer-simulated training sequences in hopes of augmenting the man's intelligence. In time, Jobe becomes noticeably brighter and also begins to fare much better with the opposite sex. As he develops psychic powers, he realizes that those around him have taken advantage of his simplicity his whole life, and he plots a bloody revenge.

programme.title: Her Smell
programme.desc: Becky Something is a talented but self-destructive musician who seems determined to alienate everyone around her -- even at the cost of her own band's success.

programme.title: Jobs
programme.desc: College dropout Steve Jobs (Ashton Kutcher), together with his friend, technical whiz-kid Steve Wozniak (Josh Gad), sparks a revolution in home computers with the invention of the Apple 1 in 1976. Built in the garage of Jobs' parents, the device -- and the subsequent formation of Apple Inc. -- have changed the world for all time. Though he is viewed as a visionary, Jobs' tenure as Apple's leader is a rocky one, leading to his eventual ouster from the company he co-founded.

programme.title: The BeastMaster
programme.desc: A psychic (Marc Singer) saves a slave girl (Tanya Roberts) from a sorcerer (Rip Torn).

programme.title: Sophie's Choice
programme.desc: Stingo (Peter MacNicol), a young writer, moves to Brooklyn in 1947 to begin work on his first novel. As he becomes friendly with Sophie (Meryl Streep) and her lover Nathan (Kevin Kline), he learns that Sophie is a Holocaust survivor. Flashbacks reveal her harrowing story, from pre-war prosperity to Auschwitz. In the present, Sophie and Nathan's relationship increasingly unravels as Stingo grows closer to Sophie and Nathan's fragile mental state becomes ever more apparent.

programme.title: 10th and Wolf
programme.desc: While serving in the military, a Marine sergeant (James Marsden) believes his family's ties to organized crime are a thing of the past. However, an act of insubordination and a visit from the F.B.I. send him packing to his South Philadelphia hometown, and he discovers that his brother (Brad Renfro) and his cousin (Giovanni Ribisi) have become entangled with mobsters, leaving him with only one way to save them.

programme.title: The Road to Wellville
programme.desc: A staunch advocate of healthy living, Dr. John Harvey Kellogg (Anthony Hopkins) opens a sanitarium that promotes his progressive, if eccentric, ideas about optimal well-being. Among the clients who arrive at the facility are the opportunistic Charles Ossining (John Cusack), who is keen on marketing Kellogg's cereal, and the wealthy Will Lightbody (Matthew Broderick) and his wife, Eleanor (Bridget Fonda). This comedy is inspired by an actual spa run by Dr. Kellogg at the turn of the century.

programme.title: House
programme.desc: In an effort to avoid spending time with her father and his creepy new lover, young Gorgeous (Kimiko Ikegami) resolves to visit her aunt's remote mansion. With six of her closest friends in tow, including the musically inclined Melody (Eriko Tanaka) and the geeky Prof (Ai Matsubara), Gorgeous arrives at the estate, where supernatural events occur almost immediately. A severed head takes flight, household appliances come to life and a portrait of a cat seems to contain an evil spirit.

programme.title: The Ron Clark Story
programme.desc: In his small North Carolina hometown, Ron Clark (Matthew Perry) leads a comfortable life as a successful elementary school teacher, earning the respect of the community. However, he knows there are students elsewhere who need him more. Following his inner calling, Clark uproots to New York City, hoping to make a difference for the disenfranchised youths the school system has left behind. Clark makes it his mission to turn around the worst students, even though he knows his job is on the line.

programme.title: Once Upon a Time in China II
programme.desc: A martial arts teacher (Jet Li) protects his students and his aunt (Rosamund Kwan) from a mercenary.

programme.title: The Marksman
programme.desc: Jim is a former Marine who lives a solitary life as a rancher along the Arizona-Mexican border. But his peaceful existence soon comes crashing down when he tries to protect a boy on the run from members of a vicious cartel.

programme.title: Basmati Blues
programme.desc: When a young scientist learns she has unwittingly aided a destructive plan against the Indian farmers she was supposedly sent to help, she teams up with a local farmer to save the day.

programme.title: Until Death
programme.desc: Anthony Stowe (Jean-Claude Van Damme) is a drug-addicted detective teetering on the edge. He shows little regard for his fellow cops, ratting out a respected veteran who takes him to task shortly before he's fired. All Stowe cares about is putting away drug-dealing former cop Callahan (Stephen Rea), who is taking over New Orleans' underworld. But Callahan's henchman (Stephen Lord) puts Stowe in a coma, and after he awakens, he realizes it's more important to redeem himself and get off drugs.

programme.title: Plan 9 From Outer Space
programme.desc: Residents of California's San Fernando Valley are under attack by flying saucers from outer space. The aliens, led by Eros (Dudley Manlove) and his assistant, Tanna (Joanna Lee), intend to conquer the planet by resurrecting corpses in a Hollywood cemetery. The living dead -- a cape-wearing ghoul (Bela Lugosi), a vampire (Vampira) and a slow-footed cop (Tor Johnson) who was killed for his nosiness -- stalk curious humans who wander into the cemetery looking for evidence of the UFOs.

programme.title: Triple 9
programme.desc: Bullets fly on the Atlanta freeway as armed thieves make their getaway following a bank robbery in broad daylight. Unhappy with the results, ruthless gangster Irina Vlaslov orders the men to pull off another job. One member of the team is Marcus Belmont (Anthony Mackie), a crooked cop who gets saddled with Chris Allen (Casey Affleck), his new but incorruptible police partner. As Belmont and his cohorts lay the groundwork for the heist, they come up with a devious plan to use Allen as their pawn.

programme.title: Rough Magic
programme.desc: In the midst of a dazzling stage show, magician's assistant Myra Shumway (Bridget Fonda) catches the eye of sleazy industrialist Cliff Wyatt (D.W. Moffett). When Wyatt unwittingly kills Shumway's mentor, a master magician, she flees to Mexico. Furious, Wyatt hires private detective Alex Ross (Russell Crowe) to capture the gorgeous witness to his crime. But, after Ross locates Shumway, he finds himself beguiled by her growing prowess as a magician -- and by the potency of her feminine charms.

programme.title: Bloodfist
programme.desc: A Los Angeles kickboxer (Don "The Dragon" Wilson) trains with a master (Joe Marie Avellana) in Manila to avenge his brother in a tournament.

programme.title: Holy Motors
programme.desc: Driven around Paris by a loyal driver (Edith Scob), a mysterious man (Denis Lavant) dresses up in costumes and plays a number of strange, semiscripted roles.

programme.title: The Big Sleep
programme.desc: Philip Marlowe (Robert Mitchum), private eye, in the 1970s London.

programme.title: Rendel: Dark Vengeance
programme.desc: Rendel, a masked superhero, becomes blinded by his desire for revenge against a sinister criminal organization.

programme.title: Red Riding: 1974
programme.desc: When a young girl goes missing, Yorkshire Post crime reporter Eddie Dunford (Andrew Garfield) becomes intrigued by a series of mysterious child murders that date back several years and mirror to the current case. He faces stiff opposition from the local police and his editor, Bill (John Henshaw). Eddie's troubles escalate when he becomes involved with a moody widow (Rebecca Hall) who has a mysterious connection to wealthy developer John Dawson (Sean Bean).

programme.title: Hopscotch
programme.desc: When CIA operative Miles Kendig (Walter Matthau) deliberately lets KGB agent Yaskov (Herbert Lom) get away, his boss (Ned Beatty) threatens to retire him. Kendig beats him to it, however, destroying his own records and traveling to Austria where he begins work on a memoir that will expose all his former agency's covert practices. The CIA catches wind of the book and sends other agents after him, initiating a frenetic game of cat and mouse that spans the globe.

programme.title: Sliding Doors
programme.desc: When Helen, a London ad executive, is fired from her job and rushes out to catch a train, two scenarios take place. In one, she gets on the train and comes home to find her boyfriend, Gerry, in bed with another woman. In the second, she misses the train and arrives after the woman has left. Following the first scenario, Helen dumps Gerry, finds a new man and gradually improves her life. Under the second scenario, she becomes suspicious of Gerry's fidelity and grows miserable.

programme.title: Chef
programme.desc: After a controlling owner (Dustin Hoffman) pushes him too far, chef Carl Casper (Jon Favreau) quits his position at a prestigious Los Angeles restaurant. As he tries to figure out what his next step should be, he finds himself in Miami. Carl joins forces with his ex-wife (Sofía Vergara), best friend (John Leguizamo) and son (Emjay Anthony) to launch a food-truck business, and the venture provides a chance to reignite his passion for cooking -- as well as his zest for life and love.

programme.title: Sakra
programme.desc: Accused of murder, a martial artist goes on the run in search of answers about his own mysterious origins and the unknown enemies out to destroy him.

programme.title: Enter the Fat Dragon
programme.desc: A police officer investigates the mysterious death of a suspect who was in his custody during a routine transfer.

programme.title: Big Brother
programme.desc: A former soldier is recruited for his toughest mission yet -- teaching a class of teen delinquents. As he kicks his way into their school and home lives, it becomes clear that his unconventional teaching style might be just what they need.

programme.title: Legend of the fist
programme.desc: Chen fakes his death and returns as a caped crime fighter.

programme.title: Raging Fire
programme.desc: Bong is a highly respected cop with a long history of success on dangerous cases. However, his past soon comes back to haunt him when his former protégé seeks revenge against all those who have wronged him.

programme.title: Sakra
programme.desc: Accused of murder, a martial artist goes on the run in search of answers about his own mysterious origins and the unknown enemies out to destroy him.

programme.title: The Swordsman
programme.desc: A swordsman who is going blind is forced to raise his sword again to save his daughter, who has been kidnapped by a slave dealer.

programme.title: Hunt the Wicked
programme.desc: Detective Huang Mingjin faces off against criminal mastermind Wei Yunzhou in a city plagued by dark secrets. As police and criminals flood the streets, Huang must unravel the city's sinister core while engaging in a cat-and-mouse game with Wei.

programme.title: Ip Man: The Awakening
programme.desc: After stopping a kidnapping, a young Ip Man becomes the target of a human trafficking ring and must face the group's brutal boxing champion head-on.

programme.title: Eye for an Eye
programme.desc: A highly trained and exceptionally deadly swordsman looks for revenge after being caught in the middle of a power struggle that results in the assassination of an innocent woman's family.

programme.title: Gundala
programme.desc: Gundala, who has grown up on the streets, must choose between continuing to look out for himself or doing something about the injustice that surrounds him.

programme.title: Gundala
